_comment: Read by the app (see MPTree-App/src/updateCheck.ts) to tell people on an older build that a newer one exists. Keep it in step with the top entry of assets/versions.js, which is what the website itself renders. Only the build handed out by this website checks this file; the Play Store build never does.
notes: Keep your music playing while another app plays sound.
Music pauses when your headphones or Bluetooth speaker disconnect.
A size setting for text and rows.
A Help section, and a moved logo button that stays put.
